expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a deletion that removed a member's pantry orders left a gap in
the counts the food bank's grant audits, which is why orders are kept without the member.
expectations.evidence: The message only says "The docs flag that deleted orders will leave gaps in grant audit counts." It does not raise the earlier incident (the 2024 deletion that left a gap auditors flagged), does not explain that orders are kept without the member on purpose or that such an order identifies no one, and makes the change without asking first and without warning the user directly that it breaks the grant's counts.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/accounts.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/accounts.md at step 8; first edit at step 17
